assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, density, height, setback and green-ratio control remain unknown in metrics.json; formal deepening requires official regulatory planning conditions.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary is the provisional rough overall-design-area polygon; the official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon has not been released by the organisers.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, metrics, figures, drawings and the visualisation are provisional; content scoring remains eligible per submission policy.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon released -> full-chain recalculation.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons (zhongzhiyuan, origin community, dazhongsi) are provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: Key-area areas in metrics.json are provisional; official announcement values (192.1 / 104.3 / 72.0 ha) are used as context only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official KEY_AREA polygons released -> recalculate key-area metrics.

assumptions.statement: Qinghuayuan station site, the heritage alignment and the Qinghe blue line are concept locations; heritage protection and blue-line conditions need official verification.
assumptions.impact: Heritage and blue-line constraints in constraints.geojson are provisional concept lines; landmark placement is conceptual.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage and blue-line data published.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept-illustrative blocks for design discussion and spatial-ratio calibration; they are not surveyed baselines or statutory schemes.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_count are illustrative; no floor-area or demolition conclusions are drawn.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Existing-building survey and ownership data become available.

assumptions.statement: Utility lines, energy loads, fire conditions and road redlines are not part of the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and new-infrastructure strategies are spatial concepts; engineering feasibility is a formal-deepening prerequisite.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official municipal and engineering data published.
